title: Dark Mediterranean
meta_description: Dark Mediterranean is an in-progress hospitality image study: one lime-washed blue resort held at dusk, sequenced from establishing shot to occupied room.
deck: An in-progress hospitality study that takes a single blue building and holds it at one moment of dusk, testing how far a grid can travel from establishing shot to occupied room without the light ever changing.

proof.title: One colour, one hour, nine distances.
proof.note: Everything in the set is the same lime-washed blue at the same blue hour. The only variable allowed to move is how close the camera stands, so the sequence reads as one evening rather than a collection of renders.

shots.alt: Dusk view through dark foliage of a stepped blue lime-washed resort building on a forested hillside, one warm-lit doorway reflected in a narrow lap pool.
shots.caption: Establishing / the approach

shots.alt: Blue corridor of receding portals framing a candlelit lounge with white cushions, terracotta vessels and a low carved table at the far end.
shots.caption: Interior / the arrival

shots.alt: Three-by-three grid of blue-hour resort frames moving from the hillside approach and pool terrace to lit windows, a laid dinner table and a single lantern.
shots.caption: Curated grid / establishing to intimate

shots.alt: Alternate three-by-three grid of the same blue resort with sea-facing terraces, a table set against a blank wall, and a parasol standing in still water.
shots.caption: Superset / the frames that did not make the cut

proof.caption: The building is never explained, only walked toward. Warm light is rationed to one window at a time so the eye has somewhere to land in all that blue.

acts.title: Establishing to intimate.
acts.note: The grid is ordered as a walk, not as a portfolio. Each row moves the viewer one distance closer to a person who is never shown.

items.title: The hillside
items.copy: The resort seen whole, through trees, from outside its own boundary.

items.title: The threshold
items.copy: Windows and doorways, each one a lit interior read from the cold side of the wall.

items.title: The table
items.copy: Dinner laid, loungers turned out, a lantern left on. Occupied, and empty.

pipeline.title: Pipeline.
pipeline.note: Built as a Runway workflow so the palette and hour stay locked while the camera distance is the only prompt that changes.

items.label: Lock
items.copy: One blue, one blue hour, one material vocabulary fixed before generation.

items.label: Generate
items.copy: A superset of frames at every distance, far more than the final nine.

items.label: Curate
items.copy: The set cut down to a nine-frame walk that only ever moves inward.

items.label: Grade
items.copy: Warm interiors protected so they survive as the single accent against the blue.
